missing_arrival_investigation.reason_not_imputed: port_events has no shipment_id or leg identifier; vessel + destination matches are ambiguous and cannot establish which shipment arrived at a given timestamp

port_event_grain_investigation.interpretation: events are port-level and vessel-linked, not shipment- or leg-linked; all event vessels appear at all reference ports, so vessel/port coincidence is not a reliable shipment join

intermediate_stop_investigation.assumption: predict destination arrival delay only; intermediate stop schedules and outcomes are not represented at shipment grain

status_target_diagnostic.modeling_decision: exclude status: observed source values reveal the target almost perfectly and are not legitimate booking-time predictors
